title: Template check: preview the next planned workout
problem: Not a real idea. This record is the second template check for the workout kit: a read-only tour that previews the next planned day and opens the program, so two different proposals can be compared for the same sections and timings.

evidence.quote_or_summary: A calendar card's eye button opens the workout dialog, the preview of a planned day, which this decision extended to finished workouts.
The fixture lifter runs GZCLP on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, with two workout days.

hypothesis: The preview names the next planned day and its three exercises, read from the fixture through the API.
acceptance_criteria: The video is 60 seconds with sections of 5, 40, 10 and 5 seconds.
The walkthrough previews the next planned GZCLP day and shows the program on the Programs tab, changing nothing.
success_signal: The same structure and timings as the other workout check and as violin's demos.
strongest_reason_not_to_build: Nothing to build: it is a test of the demo template itself.
